toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Klaspligtaak' doubles up plig and taak; 'klasplig' is the usual word.
toegepas.fout: 'Klaspligtaak' doubles plig and taak and reads as a clumsy coinage.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Klasplig' is the usual word for the same thing, and the meaning stays the same.

toegepas.voor: as wat een middag kan hou
toegepas.na: as wat in een middag pas
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Kan hou' copies English 'can hold'; 'in een middag pas' is natural Afrikaans.
toegepas.fout: 'As wat een middag kan hou' copies English 'than one afternoon can hold' when it means time.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'As wat in een middag pas' is the natural Afrikaans way to say there is too much for the time, and the meaning stays the same.

toegepas.rede_vinder: The lesson writes 'ná' for 'after' elsewhere (list, 'ná die wiskunde'); use it consistently to separate it from 'na' (towards).
toegepas.fout: 'Na' meaning 'after' lacks the accent the lesson uses everywhere else ('Ná skool', 'ná die wiskunde').
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Ná ete' is the correct spelling for 'after', and it matches the list's 'Ná ete'.

toegepas.rede_vinder: Consistent 'ná' for 'after', as in the rest of the lesson.
toegepas.fout: 'Na' meaning 'after' lacks the accent, so the spelling is inconsistent within the lesson.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Net ná ete' uses the same spelling as the rest of the lesson and does not change the meaning.

toegepas.voor: Die wiskunde moet môre in en
toegepas.na: Die wiskunde moet môre ingehandig word en
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Moet môre in' is colloquial; the full verb matches the earlier 'inhandig' and is clearer.
toegepas.fout: 'Moet môre in' is an elliptical spoken form that reads loose in a study text.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The full verb 'ingehandig word' matches 'inhandig' and 'ingehandig word' two sentences earlier, and it says the same thing more clearly.

toegepas.voor: Dalk begin dit reën of kom
toegepas.na: Dalk begin dit reën, of kom
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma before 'of' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb ('dit begin', 'iemand kom').
toegepas.fout: There is no comma before 'of' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb ('begin dit', 'kom iemand').
toegepas.rede_keurder: The AWS 2017 house rule requires the comma here, and the meaning stays the same.

toegepas.voor: Kyk aan die einde van die dag of die week wat gewerk het.
toegepas.na: Kyk aan die einde van die dag, of van die week, wat gewerk het.
toegepas.rede_vinder: After 'Kyk', 'of' first reads as 'whether'; the commas and 'van' make clear it means 'or'.
toegepas.fout: After 'Kyk', 'of die week' first reads as 'check whether the week', which makes the reader stumble.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The commas and 'van' make clear that it means the end of the day or of the week, with no change in meaning.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Die aand vooraf' is stiff; 'die vorige aand' is the natural Afrikaans phrase with the same meaning.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Die aand vooraf' is correct, natural Afrikaans for the evening before a school day, and 'die vorige aand' can read as 'last night', so this is a lateral move at best.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: A comma before 'soos' introducing examples, consistent with 'klaspligtaak, soos' in the previous block.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The comma before 'soos' is optional here, and the sentence reads well without it.

laat_vaar.voor: Sy plan het drie soorte dinge in:
laat_vaar.na: Daar is drie soorte dinge in sy plan:
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Het ... in' is a loose spoken construction; 'Daar is ... in sy plan' reads more naturally.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Sy plan het drie soorte dinge in' is ordinary natural Afrikaans, and the proposal only reads differently.

vlae.teks: iets wat jou taak of plig is om te doen of na te kyk
vlae.rede: 'Om na te kyk' can read as 'nakyk' (to check or mark) rather than 'na iets kyk' (to look after). The same wording is in the study text and the glossary and may be a shared definition, so it is flagged rather than changed; a person or the writer should decide whether a rephrasing such as 'waarvoor jy moet sorg' is wanted.
